assessments.reasoning: The terms used in the questionnaire to refer to respondents and their household relationships are directly recorded in Bloque IV of the Household Questionnaire (EPHContinua_CuestHogar.pdf) and Bloque V of the Housing Questionnaire (EPHContinua_CuestVivienda.pdf). Column 03 of Bloque IV specifies relationships to the household head as: Jefe/a, Cónyuge/Pareja, Hijo/a/Hijastro/a, Yerno/Nuera, Nieto/a, Madre/Padre, Suegro/a, Hermano/a, Otros Familiares, No Familiares. Column 04 lists the options for sex as: 1. varón, 2. mujer. In addition, Bloque V, question 3 refers to 'el jefe o jefa del hogar'.
